name: SpaceGodzilla
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to swapAndLiquifyStepv1 to prevent external callers from triggering liquidity addition at manipulated prices. Additionally, set non-zero minimum amounts in addLiquidity to enforce slippage protection.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step price/liquidity manipulation requiring understanding of the token’s custom swap/liquify logic plus LP reserve interactions, not just a trivial access-control bug. Although the flashloan setup is skipped in the PoC, the attack still involves several coordinated contract calls and protocol-specific reasoning, putting it above easy but below truly hard cases.
